rationale: The price has reclaimed the 9-EMA ($10.29) and is showing a series of higher lows on the most recent 1-minute candles, indicating a loss of downward momentum. Given the proximity to the invalidation level and the failure to break through the $10.20 support level decisively, the original thesis of a breakdown is currently invalidated. Closing the position now preserves capital and avoids the risk of a reversal against the short.
